rulings.evidence: src/strategy/engine.py:353-356 (exit_return = -stop - stop_slippage_pct); runner.py:125 default stop_slippage_pct=0.0, no caller in sweep.py/tools/walkforward_eval.py passes it (grep); load_returns TR-20260923T034514Z-6a3e1771#17: 923/1318 == -0.004737, min == -0.004737; #48: 218/302 == -0.004737, min == -0.004737; D6 table 'fill opens through the stop at the open' -10.15%
rulings.reason: Verified in the ledger: every losing trade in the candidate's train and holdout series is exactly -0.4737% (0.4% stop plus cost); no loss is ever worse, and no stop slippage is ever passed (default 0.0). With a 10-bar hold over a ~7-bar session, positions carry overnight on a 3x ETF, where gaps far exceeding 0.4% are routine; the engine still fills at the stop price. D6 shows gap-through fills alone move the live-shaped path from -5.17% to -10.15%, so this materially overstates the payoff asymmetry the edge depends on.

rulings.evidence: src/strategy/engine.py:281,304 (entries = all entry_signal != 0, iterated without position gate); load_returns #17: 1318 trades on 336 days, 61.9% <=1h, 93.5% <=2d; #48: 302 trades on 81 days, 61.6% / 92.4%; src/research/deflation.py:22-23,109-110 (daily-PnL basis); D6 table row 'allow only one open position'
rulings.reason: Verified: the engine opens a trade on every entry_signal row with no open-position gate, and the candidate's entries are heavily stacked (3.9 entries per active day; 61.9% within 1h of the prior entry). The statistical half of the objection is partly mitigated because the admission deflation measures Sharpe on daily PnL, not per trade, but the daily PnL itself sums up to several concurrent 10% positions that the one-position live bot can never hold. D6 shows one-position replay nearly halves trades and return (1516->789, +11.94%->+6.56%), so the backtest does not represent live trading of this rule.

rulings.reason: The facts check out: RSI(7)<80 is not an oversold filter, the payoff breaks even at about a 19.7% win rate (actual 29.9% train, 27.8% holdout), and returns are concentrated.
